# Security Policy

NyoAnime is a local CLI tool. It does not transmit telemetry or crash reports.

## Reporting

Report vulnerabilities privately to the maintainer rather than opening a public issue. Include:

- Affected version or commit
- Reproduction steps
- Impact assessment

## Scope

Relevant areas include command execution, file writes under `~/.nyoanime`, download path handling, and provider response parsing. Third-party provider availability and content are out of scope.
